title: Drone delivery system with autonomous navigation
abstract: A drone delivery system comprising autonomous navigation capabilities for urban environments. The system includes obstacle detection, path planning algorithms, and fail-safe landing procedures for unmanned aerial vehicles operating in controlled airspace.

title: Aerospace propulsion system with variable thrust control
abstract: An aerospace propulsion system incorporating variable thrust vector control for improved maneuverability. The system uses advanced combustion chamber design and nozzle geometry optimization to maximize fuel efficiency in high-altitude flight conditions.

title: UAV swarm coordination using distributed AI algorithms
abstract: A method and system for coordinating swarms of unmanned aerial vehicles using distributed artificial intelligence. Each UAV runs local decision-making algorithms while communicating with neighboring units to achieve collective mission objectives without centralized control.

title: Satellite attitude control system using reaction wheels
abstract: An attitude control system for low-earth orbit satellites employing reaction wheels and magnetic torquers. The system incorporates predictive control algorithms to maintain precise orbital positioning and minimize fuel consumption during station-keeping maneuvers.

title: Electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft propulsion
abstract: An electric propulsion system for vertical takeoff and landing aircraft featuring distributed motor architecture. The system provides redundancy through multiple independent propulsion units and uses machine learning to optimize power distribution across all motors during flight.

title: Hypersonic vehicle thermal protection system
abstract: A thermal protection system for hypersonic aerospace vehicles designed to withstand temperatures exceeding 2000 degrees Celsius. The system uses advanced ceramic composite materials with embedded cooling channels to manage heat flux during atmospheric reentry.

title: Autonomous drone inspection system for aircraft maintenance
abstract: An autonomous drone-based inspection system for commercial aircraft maintenance. The system uses computer vision and deep learning to detect surface defects, corrosion, and structural anomalies, generating automated maintenance reports with precise defect location mapping.

title: Aerospace fuel cell power generation system
abstract: A hydrogen fuel cell power generation system for aerospace applications providing clean auxiliary power. The system integrates with existing aircraft electrical architecture and uses advanced membrane electrode assemblies optimized for high-altitude low-pressure operation.

title: Machine learning based flight path optimization for UAV
abstract: A machine learning system for real-time flight path optimization of unmanned aerial vehicles. The system uses reinforcement learning to adapt to changing weather conditions, air traffic, and mission requirements while minimizing energy consumption and flight time.

title: Aerospace composite wing structure with embedded sensors
abstract: A composite wing structure for aerospace vehicles with embedded fiber optic sensors for structural health monitoring. The system continuously measures strain, temperature, and vibration data to predict fatigue failure and schedule preventive maintenance interventions.

title: Drone traffic management system for urban air mobility
abstract: A comprehensive traffic management system for drone operations in urban environments. The system uses AI-based conflict detection and resolution algorithms to safely coordinate thousands of simultaneous drone flights in low-altitude urban airspace.

title: Spacecraft propulsion using ion thruster arrays
abstract: An advanced spacecraft propulsion system using arrays of ion thrusters for deep space missions. The system provides precise thrust vectoring and extremely high specific impulse by accelerating xenon ions through an electromagnetic grid structure.

title: AI powered predictive maintenance for jet engines
abstract: An artificial intelligence system for predictive maintenance of commercial jet engines. The system analyzes real-time sensor data from thousands of engine parameters to predict component failures weeks in advance, significantly reducing unplanned maintenance events.

title: Solar powered high altitude pseudo satellite platform
abstract: A solar powered unmanned aerial vehicle designed for high altitude long endurance operation as a pseudo satellite. The platform uses lightweight photovoltaic cells and energy storage systems to maintain continuous flight at stratospheric altitudes for months.

title: Adaptive wing morphing system for aerospace efficiency
abstract: An adaptive wing morphing system that dynamically changes wing geometry during flight to optimize aerodynamic efficiency. The system uses shape memory alloy actuators controlled by real-time optimization algorithms responding to flight condition changes.

title: Neural network based object detection for UAV collision avoidance
abstract: A neural network system for real-time object detection and classification enabling UAV collision avoidance in complex environments. The system processes visual and lidar sensor data through convolutional neural networks to identify and track potential obstacles.

title: Hybrid electric propulsion system for regional aircraft
abstract: A hybrid electric propulsion architecture for regional commercial aircraft combining gas turbine and electric motor systems. The design reduces fuel consumption and emissions through intelligent power management that selects optimal energy sources during different flight phases.

title: Autonomous fixed wing UAV landing system using computer vision
abstract: An autonomous precision landing system for fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles using computer vision and GPS fusion. The system identifies landing zones, compensates for crosswind conditions, and executes smooth touchdowns without human intervention.

title: Rocket engine combustion instability detection using deep learning
abstract: A deep learning system for real-time detection and prediction of combustion instability in liquid rocket engines. Acoustic sensor arrays feed data into recurrent neural networks that identify precursor patterns and trigger corrective control actions before instability develops.

title: Satellite constellation management with machine learning orbit prediction
abstract: An intelligent management system for large satellite constellations using machine learning to predict orbital decay and optimize station-keeping maneuvers. The system minimizes propellant consumption while maintaining coverage requirements across the entire constellation.

title: Drone based wildfire detection and mapping system
abstract: An autonomous drone system for early wildfire detection and real-time fire boundary mapping. Equipped with thermal infrared cameras and gas sensors, the drone network continuously monitors forest areas and transmits fire location data to emergency response centers.

title: Aircraft structural health monitoring using acoustic emission sensing
abstract: A structural health monitoring system for aircraft fuselages using piezoelectric acoustic emission sensors. The system detects crack initiation and propagation by analyzing elastic wave patterns, enabling condition-based maintenance scheduling and reducing inspection costs.

title: Multi rotor drone with active vibration damping for payload stability
abstract: A multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle featuring an active vibration damping system to stabilize sensitive payloads during flight. Inertial measurement units detect vibrations and piezoelectric actuators apply counter-forces to isolate the payload from rotor-induced oscillations.

title: Space debris removal using robotic arm and net capture system
abstract: A spacecraft system for active debris removal in low earth orbit featuring a deployable net capture mechanism and robotic manipulation arm. The system uses proximity sensors and computer vision to approach and capture tumbling debris objects for controlled deorbit.

title: Quantum communication system for satellite to ground secure links
abstract: A quantum key distribution system enabling unconditionally secure communication between satellites and ground stations. The system uses entangled photon pairs transmitted through free-space optical channels to establish cryptographic keys immune to computational attacks.

title: Autonomous aerial refueling system for military UAVs
abstract: An autonomous aerial refueling system enabling unmanned combat vehicles to receive fuel from tanker aircraft without human control. Machine vision and precision guidance algorithms align the refueling probe with the tanker drogue under variable wind and turbulence conditions.

title: Liquid oxygen liquid hydrogen rocket engine with additive manufacturing
abstract: A high performance cryogenic rocket engine manufactured using metal additive manufacturing processes. The regeneratively cooled thrust chamber features complex internal cooling channel geometries that are only achievable through selective laser melting of nickel superalloy powder.

title: GPS denied navigation for UAV using visual odometry and IMU
abstract: A navigation system for unmanned aerial vehicles operating in GPS-denied environments using visual odometry and inertial measurement fusion. The system tracks visual features across sequential camera frames and integrates accelerometer data to estimate position and orientation.

title: Airborne synthetic aperture radar for ground moving target indication
abstract: An airborne synthetic aperture radar system with enhanced ground moving target indication capability. Advanced signal processing algorithms separate stationary clutter from moving targets using Doppler frequency analysis, enabling detection of slow-moving vehicles in urban terrain.

title: Solid state battery system for electric aircraft propulsion
abstract: A solid-state battery energy storage system designed for electric aircraft propulsion applications. The system uses lithium ceramic electrolyte cells achieving high energy density while eliminating thermal runaway risks associated with conventional lithium-ion batteries.

title: Hyperspectral imaging payload for environmental monitoring UAV
abstract: A compact hyperspectral imaging system designed as an unmanned aerial vehicle payload for environmental monitoring applications. The sensor captures reflected light across hundreds of spectral bands enabling identification of vegetation health, pollutant concentrations, and mineral composition.

title: Electric aircraft motor controller with fault tolerant architecture
abstract: A fault tolerant motor controller for electric aircraft propulsion systems featuring redundant power electronics and control pathways. The system detects and isolates failed components within microseconds, maintaining sufficient thrust for safe flight continuation after partial system failures.

title: Autonomous spacecraft docking using lidar and machine vision
abstract: An autonomous docking system for spacecraft rendezvous operations in orbit using lidar point cloud processing and machine vision algorithms. The system estimates relative position and velocity of the target spacecraft and executes precision approach maneuvers without ground control.

title: Variable geometry inlet for supersonic aircraft propulsion
abstract: A variable geometry engine inlet system for supersonic commercial aircraft that adjusts throat area and ramp angles to maintain optimal airflow across the flight envelope. The system uses aerodynamic modeling and actuator control to minimize total pressure losses.

title: Formation flight control for multiple unmanned aircraft systems
abstract: A distributed control system enabling multiple unmanned aircraft to maintain precise formation geometries during coordinated missions. Each aircraft communicates position and velocity data with neighbors and executes local control laws that collectively achieve desired formation shape.

title: Aircraft icing detection and protection system using AI
abstract: An artificial intelligence system for detecting aircraft icing conditions and activating protection systems before ice accumulation affects aerodynamic performance. Machine learning models trained on meteorological data predict icing probability and trigger de-icing systems preemptively.

title: Directed energy weapon system for UAV neutralization
abstract: A directed energy system for neutralizing hostile unmanned aerial vehicles using high-power laser beams. The system tracks target UAVs with optical sensors, calculates intercept parameters, and focuses laser energy on critical components to disable flight systems.

title: Terrain following radar for low altitude UAV navigation
abstract: A terrain following radar system enabling unmanned aerial vehicles to navigate at low altitudes while maintaining constant height above ground level. The forward-looking radar measures terrain profile and feeds altitude data to the flight control system for automatic terrain avoidance.

title: Distributed electric propulsion system for urban air vehicle
abstract: A distributed electric propulsion architecture for urban air mobility vehicles using multiple small electric motors integrated into the wing and fuselage structure. The design achieves aerodynamic efficiency gains through boundary layer ingestion and provides propulsion redundancy.

title: Reusable rocket landing system with autonomous guidance
abstract: An autonomous guidance and control system for reusable rocket first-stage vertical landing. Grid fins and throttleable engines are controlled by onboard computers that execute propulsive deceleration maneuvers to achieve precision landings on drone ships.

title: Satellite based ADS-B receiver for global aircraft tracking
abstract: A satellite-mounted automatic dependent surveillance broadcast receiver system providing global aircraft tracking coverage including oceanic regions. The system receives ADS-B position reports from commercial aircraft and relays them to ground networks through inter-satellite communication links.

title: Piezoelectric energy harvesting system for aircraft structural monitoring
abstract: A distributed energy harvesting network using piezoelectric transducers bonded to aircraft structural members to generate electrical power from vibration energy. The harvested energy powers wireless sensor nodes that continuously monitor structural health parameters.

title: Optical communication terminal for high bandwidth satellite links
abstract: A laser optical communication terminal for high-bandwidth data transmission between satellites and ground stations. The system employs adaptive optics to compensate for atmospheric turbulence effects and uses wavelength division multiplexing to achieve terabit-per-second throughput.

title: Autonomous helicopter blade inspection using tethered drone
abstract: A tethered drone system for autonomous inspection of helicopter rotor blades during maintenance. The drone traverses along the blade while capturing high-resolution images and ultrasonic thickness measurements, identifying delamination, erosion, and impact damage.

title: Neural network flight envelope protection system
abstract: A neural network-based flight envelope protection system that prevents pilots from exceeding aircraft structural and aerodynamic limits. The system continuously monitors flight parameters and applies control surface inputs to smoothly return the aircraft within safe operating boundaries.

title: Wireless power transfer system for drone battery charging
abstract: A wireless inductive power transfer landing pad system for autonomous charging of unmanned aerial vehicle battery systems. The system aligns the drone over charging coils using vision guidance and transfers power through electromagnetic induction without physical connectors.

title: Deployable solar array system for small satellite power generation
abstract: A compact deployable solar array system for small satellite power generation that unfolds from a stowed configuration after launch. The lightweight carbon fiber structure supports high-efficiency triple-junction solar cells providing sufficient power for scientific and communication payloads.

title: Ramjet engine with active combustion control for supersonic flight
abstract: A ramjet propulsion system with active combustion stability control for sustained supersonic flight. Fuel injection timing and atomization are modulated by feedback controllers responding to combustion chamber pressure oscillations to maintain stable combustion across the flight envelope.

title: Multispectral sensor fusion for UAV precision agriculture
abstract: A multispectral sensor fusion system mounted on unmanned aerial vehicles for precision agriculture applications. The system combines visible, near-infrared, and thermal imaging to generate crop health maps, identifying areas requiring variable rate irrigation and fertilizer application.

title: Blended wing body aircraft with laminar flow control
abstract: A blended wing body aircraft configuration with active laminar flow control using suction panels. The design integrates propulsion, structure, and aerodynamics to minimize wetted area and achieve dramatic fuel efficiency improvements over conventional tube-and-wing configurations.

title: Underwater launched UAV for maritime surveillance
abstract: An unmanned aerial vehicle designed for submarine launch from underwater torpedo tubes for maritime surveillance missions. The vehicle uses compressed gas ejection to reach the surface, then deploys wings and ignites a small turbojet engine to conduct long-range reconnaissance.

title: Phased array antenna system for LEO satellite broadband
abstract: An electronically steered phased array antenna system for ground terminals communicating with low earth orbit broadband satellite constellations. The flat panel antenna electronically tracks multiple satellites simultaneously and seamlessly hands off connections as satellites cross the sky.

title: Aircraft ice accretion simulation using computational fluid dynamics
abstract: A computational fluid dynamics-based simulation framework for predicting ice accretion on aircraft surfaces under various atmospheric icing conditions. The tool enables aircraft designers to evaluate de-icing system performance and optimize protection coverage during early design phases.

title: Additive manufactured satellite structure with integrated thermal management
abstract: A satellite bus structure manufactured using metal additive manufacturing with integrated thermal management channels. The single-piece construction eliminates fasteners and interfaces while incorporating fluid cooling passages that efficiently distribute waste heat from electronics to radiator panels.

title: Turboelectric distributed propulsion for next generation airliners
abstract: A turboelectric propulsion architecture for commercial airliners using gas turbine generators to power multiple electric fans embedded in the aircraft fuselage. The configuration ingests and re-energizes slow boundary layer air to reduce effective drag and improve fuel efficiency.

title: Deep reinforcement learning for autonomous air combat maneuvering
abstract: A deep reinforcement learning framework for training autonomous air combat maneuvering algorithms in simulated environments. The system learns to execute aggressive evasive maneuvers, missile avoidance, and weapons employment without explicit programming of tactical rules.

title: Nanosatellite constellation for global IoT connectivity
abstract: A constellation of nanosatellites providing global internet of things connectivity for remote sensor networks. The small spacecraft use store-and-forward communication protocols to collect data from ground sensors in areas without terrestrial network coverage.

title: Plasma actuator flow control for turbine blade aerodynamics
abstract: A dielectric barrier discharge plasma actuator system for active aerodynamic flow control on gas turbine compressor blades. The actuators suppress boundary layer separation under off-design operating conditions, extending stall margin and improving compressor efficiency at part load.

title: Satellite attitude determination using star tracker and gyroscope fusion
abstract: A satellite attitude determination system combining star tracker optical measurements with gyroscope angular rate data through extended Kalman filtering. The fusion algorithm provides high-accuracy attitude estimates while compensating for gyroscope drift and star tracker measurement noise.

title: UAV based search and rescue using thermal imaging and AI
abstract: An unmanned aerial vehicle system for search and rescue operations using thermal infrared imaging and artificial intelligence. The system autonomously surveys search areas, uses deep learning to distinguish human heat signatures from background clutter, and alerts rescue teams to survivor locations.

title: Electrodynamic tether system for satellite deorbit
abstract: An electrodynamic tether system for passive satellite deorbit using electromagnetic braking forces. A conducting tether deployed from the satellite generates drag through interaction with the geomagnetic field and ionospheric plasma, gradually lowering orbital altitude for atmospheric reentry.

title: Microwave power beaming system for high altitude UAV endurance
abstract: A ground-based microwave power beaming system transmitting energy to unmanned aerial vehicles at high altitude. Rectenna arrays on the aircraft convert received microwave energy to direct current power, enabling theoretically unlimited flight endurance without onboard fuel.

title: Biomimetic flapping wing micro air vehicle design
abstract: A micro air vehicle with biomimetic flapping wings inspired by insect flight mechanics. Piezoelectric actuators drive flexible wing membranes through complex flapping and twisting motions that generate lift and thrust, enabling hovering flight at scales inaccessible to rotary wing vehicles.

title: Real time air traffic flow management using genetic algorithms
abstract: A real-time air traffic flow management system using genetic algorithms to optimize aircraft routing and sequencing across the national airspace. The system balances delay costs, fuel consumption, and airport capacity constraints to minimize total system delay during congestion events.

title: Dual mode scramjet ramjet engine for hypersonic cruise missile
abstract: A dual-mode scramjet-ramjet propulsion system enabling sustained hypersonic cruise missile flight from Mach 4 to Mach 8. The engine transitions between subsonic and supersonic combustion modes as vehicle speed increases, maintaining efficient propulsion across the hypersonic flight regime.

title: Distributed aperture infrared system for aircraft missile warning
abstract: A distributed aperture infrared sensor system providing spherical missile approach warning coverage for military aircraft. Multiple infrared focal plane arrays mounted around the aircraft fuselage provide overlapping fields of view and use algorithms to detect and track approaching missile threats.

title: Satellite laser ranging system for precise orbit determination
abstract: A ground-based satellite laser ranging system that measures precise distances to satellites by timing the round-trip flight of short laser pulses. The measurements provide centimeter-level orbit determination accuracy supporting geodetic science applications and satellite navigation system calibration.

title: Pulsed detonation engine for high speed aerospace propulsion
abstract: A pulsed detonation engine using repetitive detonation waves to generate thrust for high-speed aerospace vehicles. The thermodynamic cycle achieves higher efficiency than conventional gas turbines by using detonation rather than deflagration combustion, with potential applications in hypersonic cruise vehicles.

title: CubeSat propulsion system using green monopropellant
abstract: A miniaturized monopropellant propulsion system designed for CubeSat small satellites using non-toxic green propellant. The micro thruster uses catalytic decomposition to generate hot gas for attitude control and orbit raising maneuvers while meeting spacecraft volume and mass constraints.

title: Turbofan engine nacelle with active noise control
abstract: A turbofan engine nacelle incorporating active noise control systems to reduce cabin noise levels in commercial aircraft. Microphone arrays sense engine noise and loudspeaker actuators generate cancellation signals through feed-forward and feedback control architectures targeting dominant tonal frequencies.

title: Wing tip device optimization using computational aerodynamics
abstract: A design optimization framework for aircraft wing tip devices using computational fluid dynamics simulation. Gradient-based optimization algorithms systematically vary winglet geometry parameters to minimize induced drag while satisfying structural weight and airport gate clearance constraints.

title: Lidar based terrain mapping for helicopter obstacle avoidance
abstract: A lidar-based terrain and obstacle mapping system for helicopter low-altitude flight safety. The rotating laser scanner builds three-dimensional point cloud maps of the surrounding terrain and structures, enabling automatic alerts and flight path modifications when obstacles are detected.

title: Electrostatic ion engine for deep space mission propulsion
abstract: An electrostatic ion engine providing highly efficient propulsion for deep space scientific missions. Xenon propellant is ionized and accelerated through electrostatic grids to generate thrust with specific impulse ten times higher than chemical rockets, enabling missions to the outer planets.

title: Morphing winglet system for dynamic aircraft performance optimization
abstract: A morphing winglet system that continuously adjusts wing tip geometry to optimize aerodynamic performance across changing flight conditions. Shape memory alloy actuators bend and twist the winglet structure in response to flight condition measurements, maintaining optimal vortex drag reduction.

title: Satellite thermal control using variable conductance heat pipes
abstract: A satellite thermal control system using variable conductance heat pipes with non-condensable gas reservoirs to regulate temperature across orbital thermal cycles. The passive system automatically adjusts heat pipe conductance as the satellite alternates between solar illumination and eclipse.

title: Autonomous underwater vehicle launch and recovery from UAV
abstract: A system for deploying and recovering autonomous underwater vehicles from unmanned aerial vehicles operating over ocean environments. The UAV hovers above the water surface to lower and retrieve the underwater vehicle using a retractable winch mechanism for maritime surveillance missions.

title: Software defined radio for multi-band UAV communications
abstract: A software defined radio architecture enabling unmanned aerial vehicles to communicate across multiple frequency bands using reconfigurable hardware. The system dynamically switches between radio frequency bands and modulation schemes to maintain reliable command and data links in contested electromagnetic environments.

title: Scramjet inlet design for Mach 8 flight conditions
abstract: An optimized scramjet engine inlet design for sustained hypersonic flight at Mach 8. The mixed compression inlet uses a combination of internal and external shock wave systems to efficiently decelerate incoming air to supersonic combustion chamber entry conditions while minimizing total pressure losses.

title: Active flutter suppression system for flexible aircraft wings
abstract: An active flutter suppression system for highly flexible aircraft wings using distributed piezoelectric sensors and actuators. The control system detects incipient flutter conditions from wing vibration measurements and applies corrective aerodynamic loads through control surface deflections to maintain stability.

title: Quantum dot solar cell array for satellite power systems
abstract: High-efficiency quantum dot solar cells for satellite power generation using nanocrystal semiconductor materials. The multi-junction cell architecture captures a broader spectrum of solar radiation than conventional silicon cells, achieving conversion efficiencies suitable for both near-Earth and deep-space missions.

title: Electromagnetic launch system for small satellite deployment
abstract: An electromagnetic railgun-based launch system for deploying small satellites to low earth orbit without chemical rockets. Superconducting electromagnets accelerate a sabot containing the satellite along a vacuum tube, reaching orbital velocity before the payload separates and deploys.

title: Passive gravity gradient stabilization for nanosatellites
abstract: A passive attitude stabilization system for nanosatellites using gravity gradient torques to maintain Earth-pointing orientation. A deployable boom with a tip mass creates gravitational restoring forces that naturally align the satellite with the local vertical without active control systems.

title: Aircraft engine health monitoring using oil debris analysis
abstract: An automated oil debris monitoring system for aircraft gas turbine engines that continuously analyzes metallic particles in oil to detect bearing and gear wear. Inductive sensors count and size metal debris particles, providing early warning of component degradation before functional failure occurs.

title: Geostationary satellite station keeping using electric propulsion
abstract: An electric propulsion system for geostationary satellite north-south and east-west station keeping maneuvers. Hall-effect thrusters provide highly efficient thrust for maintaining orbital position within the assigned longitude slot while dramatically reducing propellant mass compared to chemical thruster systems.

title: Aerospace structural composites with self-healing capability
abstract: Fiber-reinforced composite structural materials for aerospace applications incorporating microvascular networks filled with healing agents. When cracks form in the composite, rupturing microvascular channels release healing agents that polymerize and restore structural integrity automatically.

title: Tiltrotor aircraft conversion corridor expansion using active controls
abstract: An active flight control system expanding the conversion corridor for tiltrotor aircraft transitioning between helicopter and airplane flight modes. Model predictive control algorithms optimize nacelle angle schedules while envelope protection prevents exceedance of rotor and airframe structural limits.

title: Turbine engine compressor variable stator vane control
abstract: An intelligent variable stator vane control system for gas turbine engine compressors that optimizes vane angles throughout the operating envelope. The system uses physics-based models and sensor feedback to schedule vane positions for maximum compressor efficiency while avoiding stall and surge.

title: Satellite formation flying using differential drag control
abstract: A satellite formation flying control system using differential aerodynamic drag forces for propellant-free formation maintenance in low earth orbit. Each satellite independently adjusts its cross-sectional area to the atmospheric flow, modifying its drag force to control relative position within the formation.

title: Next generation air dominance fighter aircraft aerodynamics
abstract: Advanced aerodynamic design concepts for next-generation air superiority fighter aircraft emphasizing supersonic persistence, all-aspect stealth, and extreme agility. Conformal weapon carriage, adaptive inlet design, and tailless configuration contribute to reduced radar cross section and drag.

title: Airborne wind energy system using tethered kite drone
abstract: An airborne wind energy system using large tethered kite drones flying in crosswind patterns at altitudes where winds are stronger and more consistent. The drone drives an onboard generator and transmits electrical power to the ground through the conductive tether.

title: High altitude balloon platform for atmospheric research
abstract: A stratospheric balloon platform designed for long-duration atmospheric research missions at altitudes between 20 and 40 kilometers. The system maintains stable altitude through automated ballast release and helium venting, enabling multi-week scientific instrument operations.

title: Aircraft fuel system leak detection using distributed sensors
abstract: A distributed fuel leak detection system for aircraft using arrays of miniature chemical sensors integrated into fuel tank structures. The sensor network continuously monitors fuel vapor concentrations and pressure differentials to detect and localize fuel leaks before they create fire hazards.

title: Space launch vehicle payload fairing acoustic protection
abstract: An acoustic protection system for space launch vehicle payload fairings that attenuates the intense sound field during liftoff and transonic flight. Multi-layer composite sandwich panels with tuned vibration absorbers reduce acoustic loads on satellite payloads during the most demanding launch phase.

title: Autonomous soaring UAV using thermal updraft detection
abstract: An autonomous unmanned aerial vehicle that uses thermal updraft detection algorithms to extend flight endurance through soaring. The system identifies rising air columns using variometer measurements and GPS-referenced meteorological data, then executes circling maneuvers to gain altitude without engine power.

title: Helicopter rotor blade anti-icing system using carbon nanotube heaters
abstract: An anti-icing system for helicopter rotor blades using electrically heated carbon nanotube composite panels embedded within the blade leading edge structure. Precise thermal control prevents ice formation while minimizing electrical power consumption and weight penalties compared to conventional metallic heaters.

title: Satellite on orbit refueling and servicing system
abstract: A robotic spacecraft system for on-orbit refueling and servicing of geostationary communication satellites. The servicer vehicle uses vision-guided robotic arms to grasp client satellites, transfer propellant through standardized interfaces, and replace components to extend satellite operational lifetime.

title: High power microwave system for aircraft electronic warfare
abstract: A high power microwave directed energy system for airborne electronic warfare applications. The system generates intense microwave pulses that disable hostile electronic systems by inducing damaging currents in semiconductor devices through electromagnetic induction.
